name: SILK ROAD VOL. 2 @ HAVEN
description:
✨ Join us on Friday, September 13th, 2024, for an unforgettable Mehmuni at Sigurd! ✨

The last time we traveled the Silk Road was a truly joyous journey, so we're once again taking a trip down the Persian party road, celebrating the rich tapestry of Persian culture through music, dance, and delicious cuisine. Hosted by Sigurd CPH and DJ Ary—also known as Sanjari—in Haven, this is a night you won't want to miss!

💚🤍❤️ FOOD
Indulge in a hearty, homemade Ghormeh Sabzi, crafted with love and bursting with authentic flavors just like maman makes it. Come early and savor this traditional Persian delight!

💚🤍❤️  MUSIC
Get ready to groove to an eclectic mix of Persian beats blended with contemporary sounds, transporting you straight to the heart of a bustling Persian celebration.

💚🤍❤️  DJ LINEUP:

PERSIAN ELECTRO ORCHESTRA 💚
Kianoush Yazdanyar, a Copenhagen-based composer and producer, masterfully fuses classical Persian music with electronic genres like techno and trance. His Persian Electro Orchestra blends recorded samples from a traditional Persian orchestra with atmospheric electronica and danceable soundscapes. Accompanied by the delicate live vocals of Mahdi Ghavami, Yazdanyar’s performances are a dynamic hybrid experience that seamlessly combines DJ’ing with live santoor playing, creating an unforgettable sonic journey that redefines the boundaries of Persian music.

AMIN SAFARI 🤍
A cornerstone of Denmark’s club scene for over a decade, Amin knows exactly how to ignite the dance floor with his fresh and infectious tracks.

DJ ALIPAPA ❤️
Our favorite Persian Papi returns with his signature experimental sets, seamlessly fusing genres from the African diaspora with undeniable Persian bangers.

SANJARI (DJ ARY) 💚
Dive into the dreamscape of Sanjari, where traditional Persian melodies intertwine with dubby, house, and dance beats. After years of success as a DJ, Ary revives his passion project to deliver a captivating and immersive musical experience.

MC BANDARI 🤍
Brace yourself for an electrifying performance by MC Bandari, whose dynamic presence and spontaneous freestyles will keep the energy soaring and the crowd hyped all night long.

🥁 LIVE PERCUSSIONS BY YOHAN RAMON ❤️
Adding an extra layer of rhythm and excitement, Yohan Ramon will enchant us with his masterful percussion skills, making the night truly unforgettable.

We need your energy ⚡️⚡️ So dear doost, bring your friends and family and join us on the dance floor to keep the party alive until the early hours. This event is open to guests of all ages, so everyone is welcome to join the celebration!

Sigurdsgade 39, 2200
17 - 23
Free entrance

Psst: If you're 21 years or older, you should join the after-party: https://www.facebook.com/events/926539082827248/

name: KLUB WERKSTATT: LOFT GROOVE
description:
KLUB WERKSTATT: LOFT GROOVE

For the third time, we are thrilled to welcome you to Loft Groove - a homage to the legendary spirit of dance and community fostered by the iconic "The Loft" nightclub in New York City. 
Loft Groove embodies the fusion of past and present, where disco and house music converge to create an immersive experience.
The "Loft Groove Collective" consists of DJs Ian Bang, Kris Percy and Ziggy Phunk.
Combined, they have more than half-century of experience behind the decks, and a shared passion for crafting unforgettable sonic journeys.
Together, they fuse disco, house, and everything in between into a sonic tapestry that will elevate your senses and move your soul.
Like its namesake, Loft Groove is more than just a party; it is a haven for those who seek connection, expression, and above all, the undeniable power of music to uplift and unite.
Whether you're a seasoned aficionado or a newcomer to the scene, Loft Groove invites you to join the collective, to lose yourself in the music, and become a part of the legacy that is Loft Groove - where your groove smile will stay on your face until the next week, and the spirit of "The Loft" lives on.

name: Nordic India Startup Summit by TechBBQ & ICDK
description:
Are you a Nordic founder or investor looking to make new connections in the global startup ecosystem?

Join us at the Nordic India Startup Summit!

Produced and powered by TechBBQ and Innovation Centre Denmark, the Nordic India Startup Summit (NISS) is a one-day event on September 9th, 2024, providing a unique opportunity to connect with India’s startup ecosystem, top unicorns, and startup leaders.

By attending, you can:

1. Meet startup founders: Connect with founders and investors from India's thriving startup scene.

2. Explore investment opportunities: Seek investment and funding for your business.

3. Learn from trends: Engage in knowledge-sharing activities on the Nordics and India, the third-largest startup ecosystem globally.

4. Hear success stories: Watch unicorn founders speak about their experiences growing their businesses.

Visit our website for a rundown of our startup and unicorn speakers, partners, and program:

https://techbbq.dk/nordic-indiastartupsummit/ 

Now is your chance to take your first step in building the Nordic-Indian corridor.

Tickets are limited. We encourage you to secure your spot at the earliest opportunity.

name: TechBBQ 2024
description:
🔥TechBBQ 2024🔥

✨ Get ready for another round of the most hygge ‘tech & innovation’ summit in the Nordics!

✨ Our yearly event brings together thousands of like-minded people and helps connect the Nordic and Baltic startup ecosystem with the rest of the world. Every September, we gather the tech community to help inspire and connect startups, scaleups, entrepreneurs, investors, business angels, tech talents, innovation enthusiasts and ecosystem builders looking for fresh opportunities.

✨ Don't miss out on talks about the latest tech trends by trendsetting and inspiring speakers, networking in a cozy and former locomotive workshop space, and a good old-fashioned BBQ in the garden!

What to expect:
💥 2 days jam-packed with an inspiring stage program, networking & showcasing
💥 8000+ attendees
💥 Insightful keynote talks & panel discussions across 8 stages
💥 Garden sessions led by industry leaders
💥 Startup exhibitions
💥 Pitching competitions
💥 Access to afterparties
💥 Lots of 'hygge' vibes 
💥 Access to side events around Copenhagen

About TechBBQ
TechBBQ is a non-profit organization created by the community for the community with the goal of supporting and accelerating the Nordic and Baltic tech startup ecosystems. We are the pulse of innovation and technology in the Nordics.

💡 Learn more on our website: https://techbbq.dk/
